'''Leftan Harris''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the [[Intarsa League]] criminal faction during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Harris and the League were aboard a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] traveling en-route the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] on a mission to setup a shell company as a front for their operations when they were attacked by a rival group of criminals. The shuttle crashed in the grounds of the [[Blue Star Centre]], a [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophical]] research facility and Harris and the surviving members of the Intarsa League entered the facility and took its inhabitants hostage in an attempt to gain passage off of Cularin. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in and around the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], [[Skirmish in the Blue Star Centre|attacked]] the Intarsa League and defeated Harris and the other crash survivors to free the hostages.
